## Summary / 改动概述
<!-- What problem does this solve, and why is this change needed? / 解决什么问题，为什么修改？ -->

## Changes / 主要改动
<!-- Describe behavior and implementation at a useful review level. / 简述功能和实现变化。 -->

-

## Verification / 验证方式
<!-- Exact commands or manual steps and their results. If untested, explain why. / 填写实际执行的命令或测试步骤及结果；未测试请说明原因。 -->

-

## Compatibility and risks / 兼容性与风险
<!-- Behavior changes, data/schema migration, breaking changes, performance, security, rollback. Write "None" when not applicable. / 行为变化、数据迁移、破坏性变更、性能、安全与回退；不涉及时填 None。 -->

-

## Related issues / 关联 Issue
<!-- Use "Fixes #123" when this PR should close an issue on merge, or "Refs #123" for references only. -->

## Checklist / 提交前检查
- [ ] The change is scoped and understandable; unrelated changes are excluded. / 改动范围清晰，无无关改动
- [ ] Relevant tests were run, or the reason for not running them is documented. / 已测试或说明未测试原因
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private records or personal data were committed. / 未提交密钥、凭据或敏感信息
- [ ] User-facing changes or migration requirements are documented when applicable. / 必要时已补充文档及迁移说明

<!-- For UI changes, attach before/after screenshots if useful. / UI 改动可在下方添加前后截图。 -->
